en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a small European town along a river. On the left is a timber‑framed house built directly on a stone embankment; at center and right are several houses and a larger building behind trees. A road slopes upward from the riverside, with a low stone wall and fences. On the right spans an iron lattice footbridge or small road bridge across the river. Printed red text at the top identifies the town and vantage point; a red handwritten number appears in the upper right corner.
